items.title: 66096_Monk Montgomery oral history interview
items.q: at one time he had brought in Jimmy Smith.

ctx.x: So you were assaulting the hotels?

Right. I spoke to one guy, and I felt like I had really made a breakthrough. It was at the Hilton. And he had the reputation of being one of the most liberal-minded of them all. It was Dave...David...oh, God, I forgot that man's name... I think I'll mention it in a minute. And he was the entertainment director for the Hilton. And he had been over to the Caesar's for a lot of years, and at one time he had brought in Jimmy Smith. He tried it with...he had Duke Ellington and he had, he brought in Sarah Vaughan. He…

And I called him to make an appointment with him, and he said, 'Well, come on in.' And that shocked me, because he was ready, here, he invited me in. I didn't think it would happen at a major hotel, that major hotel, the Hilton. But it was because of the man, you see, the entertainment director.
